assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production transparent 3x3 sprite sheet for a 2D arcade game. Edit target: supplied six-frame blue penguin walk sheet. Redraw as the SAME recognizable blue penguin, same large face, yellow beak and yellow feet, now a skilled Peruvian park engineer: well-fitted orange reflective work vest with folds and seams, white rounded construction hard hat replacing propeller hat, brown work gloves, a realistic small steel spade with wooden handle firmly gripped in both wings. Clothing, body and shovel must be ONE cohesive hand-drawn pixel-art figure per frame, not separate stickers. Detailed polished 32-bit arcade pixel art, dark colored outline, consistent lighting and proportions. Exactly NINE separate complete full-body figures on a uniform 3-column by 3-row grid, transparent background, no shadows outside figure, no text or borders. Row1: walking contact right leg forward, walking down passing, walking left leg forward. Row2: walking opposite contact, passing opposite, walking right forward again, completing a coherent six-frame walk cycle. Row3: windup raising spade, attack slamming spade blade into ground in front right with knees bent, defeated sitting with X eyes holding spade beside body. All face right in 3/4 view. Every cell same body scale and ground baseline, figure and tool fully inside its cell with generous margins. Preserve original color identity and friendly caricature face. No floating accessories, duplicated hands, cut limbs, gradients in background, checkerboard or labels.
